cementumExtraCem.title: Official ExtraCEM 500 product page

cementumExtraCemTds.title: Official ExtraCEM 500 technical sheet, updated 2025-07-09
cementumExtraCemTds.evidence: Official TDS states 40 kg paper bags, GOST 31108-2020, limestone up to 20%, and separate plant variants with differing class letter and two-/28-day strength values. Because MAT's plant is not identified, age-specific strengths and shelf-life mapping are not forced into scalar slots.
